annotations.title: What a place really costs, from Trip720

description: Trip720's checked facts for one destination, for travellers from Australia or the UK: what a day costs a person for food and getting around (street food, balanced, mostly restaurants), local transport and taxi prices, tourist tax, the most pleasant months, the visa for that home country, the sights not to miss with tips, and the total of a sample priced trip. Each figure comes from Trip720's research with its sources, in AUD or GBP. Read only; no booking or search is made. Places not covered say so and list the covered places in that country.

homeCountry.description: Where the traveller lives: AU (Australia) or GB (the UK). AU when not given.

place.description: A town, island or country, e.g. 'Kyoto', 'Bali', 'Japan'.
